description: List documents you've previously uploaded via this MCP server on this machine. Returns document_id, title, share_url, share_permission, created_at, and expires_at for each — does NOT return the admin credential. Use this to help the user find and resume older documents without re-pasting admin URLs. Does NOT include documents created via the mdshare web UI or via direct API calls from other clients — only those created by this MCP server. Returns an empty array on a fresh install or after the local store has been cleared.
name: list_my_documents
